A report of a step test, as a web page

Source: R/test-report.R
test_report.Rd

Writes the default report of a step test in one call: the header with the athlete's details, LT1 and LT2 with what they mean, the training zones, the predicted performance, what to double-check, the test, and every method. Open it in a browser, or print it to PDF from there, or set pdf = TRUE: two A4 pages, the answer and the zones on the first, the record on the second (a section moves to the next page whole). To choose the sections, their order, or to add your lab's name and logo, build the report step by step with report_start(). Needs the gt package.

Usage

test_report(
  x,
  file = "lactate-test-report.html",
  athlete = list(),
  lt1 = NULL,
  lt2 = NULL,
  protocol = NULL,
  notes = NULL,
  pdf = FALSE,
  open = interactive(),
  dates = NULL
)

Arguments

x

The result of lactate_threshold(), or a list of two to five of them with their dates.

file

Where to write the report, an .html file.

athlete

A named list for the header, passed to report_header(), e.g. list(name = "Ana Silva", date = "3 November 2026", sex = "female", age = 27, body_mass = 61).

lt1, lt2

The thresholds that mark LT1 and LT2, as in lactate_zones().

protocol

One line on how the test was done: ergometer, stages, sampling site, analyzer. Not shown for a series.

notes

Free text for the end of the report.

pdf

Whether to print a PDF next to the HTML file as well. Needs the pagedown package and Google Chrome or Chromium.

open

Whether to open the report in the browser.

dates

With a list of two to five tests in x, the date of each test (dates, or days since the first test). The report then starts with the progress over the tests, and describes the latest one.

Value

the path of the report, invisibly.

See also

report_start() to build a report step by step.

Examples

results <- lactate_threshold(
  demo_data, intensity, lactate, heart_rate, rpe_column = rpe, plot = FALSE
)
report <- test_report(
  results,
  file = tempfile(fileext = ".html"),
  athlete = list(name = "Demo athlete", date = "3 November 2026", body_mass = 72),
  protocol = "Cycle ergometer, 3-min stages of +25 W from 50 W, earlobe capillary blood",
  open = FALSE
)
